Results.ReviewText: Can’t remember when I bought this grill, so I just made up something for the registration. We sold these at work ( Bass Pro Shops ), and I bought it with my points and employee discount. It replaced a big square charcoal grill of another brand that finally needed to be replaced. I do wish that there was a way to adjust the distance between coals and food, but we get by okay. I have the Weber Smokey Mountain Smoker, so I do not normally use the grill as a smoker too. The grill is easy to cook on once you learn how to control the heat and not overpower your food. We grill lots of veggies and some do well on a SS grill pan. I am pretty decent cook, but most of my meat comes out a litter more towards the medium to medium well side. I like it rare, but my wife is happy. I am still learning how to do steaks, and do recommend the Weber How To Grill and How to Smoke books as invaluable resources. The websites for both are excellent resources too. I wish that the grill lid came with a reliable way to hang the lid off of the side while tending to the food. I will probably add the charcoal baskets this year as I expand cooking repertoire. My son has both the Weber WSM and the Grill too and gives me tips. I will never ever return to a gas grill, ever. They are quality built grills, pretty well thought out. Some years find me cooking a heavy volume of Venison and Jalapeño peppers, and the grill does will with my recipes.

Weber grills are very well designed and manufactured; sturdy and the temperature control and heat circulation enhances the ability of any chef to produce a mouth watering product, whether using direct or indirect methods. Also, the Weber website is very beneficial, as is the Weber Grilling Manual, utensils and the various accessories available.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill to replace my older basic Weber kettle grill I have had for around 15 years. This model has a couple added features such as a thermometer in the lid, hinged cooking grate and an ash receptacle. I see no reason why this unit should not perform as well and last as long as my last unit. These grills are a simple proven design that works well for any skill level charcoal griller. As with any product, there are higher end models with additional features and substantially higher prices, but they are not worth the added cost in my opinion. At the end of the day whether you use the low end basic model or the top of the line premium model, you are just cooking food on a grate above burning charcoal. If you can master that, then any weber model will do the job well.

Results.ReviewText: I got this kettle about a month ago. When I got it home it had a damaged handle and out of round lid. Weber sent me a replacement lower and lid. Took some time but I got the one touch scrapers swapped over. Only issues I have now is the vent on the lid free spins with no restrictions. When I cook on it I have to keep an eye on the vent because with enough wind it will move. Also the thermometer is almost useless as when you smoke or slow cook food you want your vent opposite the heat and smoke and that puts the thermometer right above the coals. Would make more sense to have it lower on the lid and closer to the vent.  Makes it tough to do some real low and slow. I would recommend to really go over your kettle and address any issues you have, they aren't made like the old ones anymore.

Results.ReviewText: Grilled some chicken thighs on my first try. Seriously, they were the best I've ever done on a barbecue! The grill stayed hot for plenty of time for them to be thoroughly cooked, and they were delicious. So this grill really does a great job of what it is supposed to do. I love the grill, but just 4 stars, because I feel there could still be improvement in the special features. I  I love the ash dump on this model, but find it a bit difficult to remove/replace. Is it because I'm a weakling and my fingers just can't seem to squeeze the handles together far enough? (In addition, I wish this model had the upper damper that had the handle that stays cool enough to move with bare hands - but that's my fault for buying the wrong model, I suppose). Also, it seems like when the 1-touch cleaning system still leaves quite a lot of ashes that need to be pushed out by hand. I do love the copper color! Mostly, I love that it does a great job of cooking food to perfection! That's really what matters most!

Results.ReviewText:
After assembling the grill I was disappointed to find that the lid did not sit on the kettle.  I contacted Weber and it turned out that both lid and kettle were out of round and twisted.  The supplied new lid and kettle that fit together nicely.  Then I had to disassemble the kettle and reassemble it.

I have noticed that the vent control on this grill can't be moved to the leg, as that leaves an opening, so not totally cutting air to the coals.

I would also suggest the lid hanger hook could be a little longer as it is hard to catch it.  Better than last grill, whose lid tended to fall off when I hung it, sometimes not immediately.  Led to damage to lid and ultimate demise as the lid handle eventually broke off.  Having said that it still lasted 12 years!

Having used it now, I think this one does not cook as well as the old one.  My prior Weber did not have the fancy coal catcher feature, and perhaps this changes airflow through the kettle.  Also makes it a little more difficult to adjust the temperature, as the handle is a little difficult to reach.

Reading the manual, I have been able to use less charcoal with this version.

It is still a good grill and would not hesitate to recommend it.

Customer support was good. If you have a problem contact them on their Facebook page.

First of all there’s nothing better than cooking on a Weber kettle. I’ve used them before but this is the first that I’ve owned and I’ll have a hard time going back to gas (even if it is quicker) because the flavor is so much better. so that said the reason I’ve given it 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the assembly. 

The leg material is a little thin and flimsy but plenty strong enough for the application. My main complaint is how the legs attach. The spring loaded pins that hold the legs in place on the kettle are annoying to work with and took some frustrating manipulation to get them to lock in place properly when following the directions. Weber would’ve been much better served using a pin with a cotter pin to hold them in place, it would’ve been much faster and easier for both assembly and disassembly (in the odd event you’d need to take it apart). Also on my grill one of the legs didn’t want to cooperate going into its home and was so tight that the finish on the inside of the kettle has a circle shaped crack in it because I had to push so hard. Also the lid hook is largely useless because it’s difficult to get it to stay on the rim of the grill. I just ended up placing the lid on the ground initially because if you hang it on a handle it melts the plastic grip cover. I was thankfully able to find a clip on lid holder on Amazon that fixed the issue. I probably sound petty for that but I’ve had back issues recently and it makes it much easier to not have to bend over. 

All in all I love this grill, it’s near perfect and you can’t beat it for the money/value. With a few small inexpensive tweaks on Weber’s end it would be completely perfect.
Results.Title: Phenomenal grill, second to none, but small flaws

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is absolutely the most versatile piece of equipment I own.  It cooks hot and fast (600+°) all the way down to slow and low.

Heat management is simple and fuel consumption is very reasonable. 

The amount and variety of accessories available make this a one-stop shop for all cooking needs.

I can't believe I waited so long to buy one of these...

Results.Title: Super grilling!st

Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We've had Weber kettles in my family for over 50 years and our latest kettle is the best yet!  Easy to clean, large cooking surface, and cooks just wonderfully. We appreciate the new technology and the traditional design.  Thank you, Weber, for making such a great grill!
Results.Title: The best!

Results.ReviewText: I bought my first Weber and I’m glad I made the right choice.  I can noticed a huge difference from all my other grills.  It cooks and maintains heat better than my other grills in the past and not to mention how easy and available replacement parts are .

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
